paragraphs.source_en: Ikeda Shōnyū climbed the watchtower of Inuyama Castle and gazed at the fine view—the walls stretching away to the south and the Kiso River to the north. Beside him stood his son Motosuke and his son-in-law, Mori Musashi-no-kami Nagayoshi. The handsome, gallant Mori Nagayoshi was also narrowing his eyes as he admired the scenery. The guards stood ready some distance away; there was no chance that the three men's conversation would reach their ears.
